elements_selected.content: `zetl cap` subcommand dispatcher with stubs for every verb listed in REQ-3416: `genkey`, `invite`, `list`, `revoke`, `rotate`, `finalise`, `share`, `check`, `sweep`, `pair`, `audit-diff`, `rotate-signing-key`, `emergency-shutdown`. Each stub exits with a `not-yet-implemented` message and follows SPEC-004 exit codes (0/1/2/64+). `--help` text for every verb. `--output json` support plumbed through (even if verb body returns stub). Help output + exit codes testable via `assert_cmd`.
